repairs: Pinned per-request informational evidence with read-failure metadata and independent copies; ContextVar prevents concurrent requests swapping sources.
Common reasoning bundle for Ask Atlas and dashboard; fresh automation data wins over stale runtime execution copies.
Blocked/HOLD decisions cannot become allowed merely because automation is enabled. Candidate readiness remains separate from infrastructure readiness.
Standalone voice now loads learning state; comparison metadata is derived from its captured status rather than a second status read.
Dashboard, typed and voice reasoning use the most recent 160 risk/learning events instead of incompatible learning-only and all-event windows.
Compact cross-process conversation memory with 20-turn/four-hour retention, file locking, evidence references and basic credential redaction.
Broker-confirmed outcome claims require account-scoped closed-position proof, separate from unverified/historical learning examples.
Adaptation latency and learning-speed scores explicitly labelled heuristic estimates.

runs.scope: coordination, outcome proof, Brain v2, follow-ups, voice relevance, relevance guard, adaptation, universal engine, cognitive core, command orchestration, voice commands, UI, closed-outcome counter
legacy brain, control, knowledge, recommendations, performance feedback, paper tuning and comparison intelligence

brain_safety.policy_note: Cognitive core is Atlas' AI coordination layer. It may design strategy proposals, but does not change strategy, risk, or execution policy without the guarded promotion path.

deployment.backend: graceful restart after matching demo account verified flat with no pending orders

limitations: This repairs coordination and reporting, not trading profitability or validated strategy learning.
Captures are per request, not cross-file atomic transactions. Independent requests can legitimately refer to different backend decisions.
Adaptation numbers remain heuristics; their provenance is explicit, not converted into real measured latency.
The conversational brain remains separate from trading authority and cannot rewrite strategies or retrain itself.
Voice-mode reasoning and source/memory handoffs were tested; a spoken microphone-to-transcription acceptance test was not performed.
Only active answer/dashboard/voice coordination was unified; legacy compatibility modules were retained.
